result.markdown:
# South Traffic Drop Due to Fiber Link Loss

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SUD-02-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarm evidence on the link and sites precisely matches the timing of the traffic drop and the maintenance window.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-03 22:30 to 2026-09-04 02:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-03 22:39
- **Affected:** S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005, LNK-SUD-02-B

## Summary

Loss of optical signal on shared fiber link LNK-SUD-02-B during maintenance window MW-0001 cut off sites S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005.

Traffic, active users and availability dropped to zero on sites S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005 for over four hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-03 22:12: Maintenance MW-0001 started on LNK-SUD-02-B. [MW-0001]
- 2026-09-03 22:30: Traffic and availability anomaly started on S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005. [ALR-0001]
- 2026-09-03 22:39: Critical LINK_LOS raised on LNK-SUD-02-B. [ALM-000037]
- 2026-09-03 22:40: Critical SITE_DOWN raised on S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005. [ALM-000038, ALM-000039]
- 2026-09-04 02:42: LINK_LOS cleared on LNK-SUD-02-B. [ALM-000037]
- 2026-09-04 02:45: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared and anomaly ended on S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005. [ALR-0001, ALM-000038, ALM-000039]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005 experienced availability and traffic drops between 2026-09-03 22:30 and 2026-09-04 02:45. [ALR-0001]
- Shared parent link LNK-SUD-02-B suffered a critical LINK_LOS alarm at 2026-09-03 22:39. [ALM-000037]
- Maintenance window MW-0001 for optical power measurements overlapped the incident on LNK-SUD-02-B. [MW-0001]
- Both S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005 raised critical SITE_DOWN alarms at 2026-09-03 22:40. [ALM-000038, ALM-000039]
- No changes occurred on S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005 and their parents between 2026-09-03 18:00 and 2026-09-04 06:00. [T3]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-02-B: confirmed. Direct link loss of signal alarm on LNK-SUD-02-B caused simultaneous site outages on S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005 during maintenance. [ALM-000037, ALM-000038, ALM-000039, MW-0001]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No configuration changes were executed on S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005 or their parent nodes during the query window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T3: No changes were found on the affected sites or their ancestors during the incident window.
- T7: No external events were recorded across any region during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Review optical power measurement procedures during maintenance windows to prevent unexpected link signal loss.
- Verify redundant path configurations for S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-005 to minimize single point of failure impact.

## Sources

- `MW-0001`: completed window 2026-09-03 22:12 -> 2026-09-04 03:14 on LNK-SUD-02-B: Optical power level measurements on LNK-SUD-02-B; expected impact: None expected (measurement only)
- `ALR-0001`: ended alert from 2026-09-03 22:30: 2 site(s) (S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005); region-level SUD; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb
- `ALM-000037`: critical LINK_LOS on LNK-SUD-02-B, raised 2026-09-03 22:39, cleared 2026-09-04 02:42
- `ALM-000038`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SUD-004, raised 2026-09-03 22:40, cleared 2026-09-04 02:45
- `ALM-000039`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SUD-005, raised 2026-09-03 22:40, cleared 2026-09-04 02:44
- `T3`: get_changes(start=2026-09-03 18:00, end=2026-09-04 06:00, node_ids=['S-SUD-004', 'S-SUD-005'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005 and its parents between 2026-09-03 18:00 and 2026-09-04 06:00.
- `T7`: get_external_events(start=2026-09-03 18:00, end=2026-09-04 06:00) -> No external events for all regions between 2026-09-03 18:00 and 2026-09-04 06:00.

Settled by: the window's expected impact says none (measurement only), so it fails the nature test of the maintenance runbook: measurements do not take downstream sites off the air.
